behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert shorthand/long uppercase parsing, canonical output and nonopaque alpha.
Assert positive/negative/endpoint shifts, rounding, frozen nonmutation and validation order.
docDelivery: Document supported hex syntax, byte alpha and canonical output.
Explain interpolation/rounding, amount range and pure core composition.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Hex RGBA byte colors with immutable interpolation toward black/white, exact rounding and alpha preservation.
manualBehavior: adjustColor composes shared parse/shift/format helpers without duplicate policy.
independence: Separate color parsing, transformation and output formatting preserving clamping, rounding and alpha behavior.
